title: Best thing I've hung on my walls probably ever.
text: Best thing I've hung on my walls probably ever.. Never thought I'd make a review for a wall hook but this thing is amazing, it's mega easy to install and once it's on it's there forever, I used it for my bathroom wall and it's the best, both of my soap holders fell from the walls for some reason whilst this stayed on and hasn't even moved one inch, looks good as new and it seems to support a good amount of weight on it as well, I'm sure it'd work for anything else as well hanging on kitchen or doors maybe, I may or may not buy more of these, I haven't even tried removing it so I don't know if it's easy to remove or not but it shouldn't be that difficult, looks great for me ! Also completely waterproof and looks good which is something I'd had trouble finding.
